# MarsScape Balance Baseline

*Generated by `npm run sim`. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate after any data or
formula change; a regression is any method losing >10% xp/hr, any new NO SOURCE /
NO SINK flag, or any verdict flipping to FAIL.*

Tick = 600 ms · Sol = 100 ticks · XP curve: RuneScape (99 = 13,034,431 xp)

Focused-play assumptions: best pick allowed at each level (steel@5, titanium@12,
laser@20), Reinforced Drills from L30, Deep Drilling / Cryo Insulation from L55, no
equipment bonuses — gear makes real play faster than these tables.

## Travel: rover and Piloting cut cross-region time

| Destination | Rover | Piloting 1 | Piloting 40 | Piloting 99 |

| Dune Sea | Survey Buggy | 20 ticks | 15 ticks | 8 ticks |
| Dune Sea | Rover Mk2 | 14 ticks | 9 ticks | 4 ticks |
| Dune Sea | Rover Mk3 | 10 ticks | 5 ticks | 4 ticks |

**Travel check:** **PASS** — both a better rover and higher Piloting strictly reduce travel time.

## The Great Storm

250 ticks, 10 phases of 25. The Survival ladder (low-O2 grace at 25,
surge softening at 40, emergency beacon at 50) plus suit O2 efficiency give late-game
colonists real storm tools.
